source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Identify all advertised specifications.
3. Cross-reference the advertised specifications with the test results.
4. Clearly note any discrepancies between the test results and the advertised performance.
5. Include specific data points where failure occurs, such as time, location, or environmental conditions.
6. Explain the methodology used in testing for reproducibility and verification.
7. Provide detailed notes on the conditions under which the product failed to meet specifications.
8. Include photographs, graphs, charts, or video recordings to support your findings.
9. Use clear, concise language to describe the failed performance.
10. Be objective and avoid personal judgment or emotional language.
11. Note any warning signs or indicators before the failure occurred.
12. Record any attempts to rectify or troubleshoot the failure and their outcomes.
13. Accompanying each failed specification, state the impact on consumer experience or safety.
14. Mention the product manufacture date or version to help identify affected batches.
15. Provide
